name: Square-Leg Bar Stool
description: Bar-height stool: a 350 mm round seat at 750 mm on four 35 mm square legs with two footrest rails at 250 mm.

steps.instruction: Create the stool seat: a 350 mm diameter disc, 30 mm thick, centered on the Z axis with its top face at Z=750 (disc from Z=720 to Z=750).

transcript.user_prompt: Make a bar stool. Start with the seat: a round disc 350 mm in diameter and 30 mm thick, centered on the Z axis with its top face at bar height Z=750 (so it spans Z=720 to Z=750).
transcript.assistant_message: I've created the 350 mm round seat, 30 mm thick, floating at the 750 mm bar-stool height.

steps.instruction: Add four 35 x 35 mm square legs from Z=0 to Z=720, centered at X=+/-100, Y=+/-100, fused with the seat.

transcript.user_prompt: Add four vertical legs, each 35 x 35 mm square, running from the floor at Z=0 up to the seat's underside at Z=720, centered at X=+/-100 and Y=+/-100, fused with the seat.
transcript.assistant_message: Four 35 mm square legs now carry the seat, set on a 200 mm square under the disc.

steps.instruction: Add two footrest rails along X at Y=+/-100: each 235 mm long (spanning the legs' outer faces), 35 mm wide and 30 mm tall, from Z=250 to Z=280, fused through the legs.

transcript.user_prompt: Add a footrest: two rails running along X at Y=+/-100, each 235 mm long so they span flush to the legs' outer faces, 35 mm wide and 30 mm tall, from Z=250 to Z=280, fused through the legs.
transcript.assistant_message: Both footrest rails are in at 250-280 mm - the stool frame is complete.
